grammar.title: Opening or separating with V + 开
grammar.explanation: 开 (kāi) after a verb shows something opens up or moves apart — "push open, move away, separate". It's a common resultative complement, as in 推开 (push open), 走开 (go away), and 分开 (split apart).

grammar.title: Just, merely with 只是
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 只是 + 动词/形容词短语
grammar.explanation: 只是 (zhǐshì) means "just, merely, only" — it softens a statement by saying something is nothing more than what's mentioned. It often appears in explanations that downplay a situation, narrowing the claim to one small fact.

sentences.zh: 经过努力，他终于成功了。
sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò nǔlì, tā zhōngyú chénggōng le.
sentences.en: After much effort, he finally succeeded.

sentences.zh: 除了汉语，他还会说英语。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle Hànyǔ, tā hái huì shuō Yīngyǔ.
sentences.en: Besides Chinese, he can also speak English.

sentences.zh: 除了看书，我还喜欢运动。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle kànshū, wǒ hái xǐhuan yùndòng.
sentences.en: Besides reading, I also like sports.

sentences.zh: 除了她，我也认识他的家人。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle tā, wǒ yě rènshi tā de jiārén.
sentences.en: Besides her, I also know his family.

sentences.zh: 除了工作，他还要照顾孩子。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle gōngzuò, tā hái yào zhàogù háizi.
sentences.en: Besides work, he also has to take care of the kids.

sentences.zh: 这个城市没有北京这么大。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì méiyǒu Běijīng zhème dà.
sentences.en: This city isn't as big as Beijing.
